column3: The Version tab lists Typesense releases and install actions.
The Service tab lists installed versions and local paths.
Open Configuration to inspect the Typesense server settings.
The Log tab shows the Typesense startup output.
The service log reports Typesense listening on port 8108.
A local raft status page opens in the browser.
The raft page shows the default group as leader.
Open the vars page to inspect process values.
The flags page lists runtime options and descriptions.
The RPC page offers optional recent-call tracking.
The heap page reports that the profiler is not enabled.
The local page links its status and health routes.
Return to the Typesense service tab.
The service list refreshes the installed releases.
